// reasons.about: W11 (QUALITY_BAR §2) runs html-validate on the static snapshot or the rendered DOM. Correctness and accessibility rules stay on as errors; purely stylistic rules, and rules that only flag how a browser serialises a DOM, are off. lib/instruments/htmlvalidate.mjs strips every key starting with // before handing this file to html-validate (its schema accepts no extra keys).
// reasons.extends: html-validate:recommended plus html-validate:document (missing-doctype, input-missing-label, no-missing-references, heading-level, require-sri) because every input is a whole document.
// reasons.attr-case: off: attribute names are case-insensitive in HTML; serialised SVG keeps camelCase (viewBox).
// reasons.attr-delimiter: off: whitespace around = is valid HTML; a style choice.
// reasons.attr-quotes: off: unquoted, single- and double-quoted values are all valid; a style choice.
// reasons.attribute-boolean-style: off: hidden and hidden="" are equivalent; browsers serialise the second form, so it would fire on every snapshot.
// reasons.attribute-empty-style: off: same as attribute-boolean-style for empty values.
// reasons.no-inline-style: off: style attributes are valid; the builder contract itself sets CSS custom properties inline (style={{"--i": index}} for reveal staggering). CSP is not part of W11.
// reasons.prefer-button: off: <input type=submit> is valid; preference only.
// reasons.prefer-tbody: off: the parser inserts <tbody>; a style choice in source and never present in a serialised DOM.
// reasons.no-implicit-input-type: off: <input> without type is a text input by definition.
// reasons.tel-non-breaking: off: typographic preference (non-breaking spaces inside phone link text).
// reasons.script-type: off: only flags a redundant type=text/javascript, which is harmless.
// reasons.long-title: off: SEO preference, and the platform writes the published <title> (W5 also excludes it).
// reasons.require-sri: off: subresource integrity is a security policy for third-party assets, not markup validity; published Makeborne sites load same-origin bundles.
// reasons.valid-id: relaxed: HTML5 allows any id without whitespace; React useId produces ids such as «r0» or :r0: that the strict pattern rejects.
// reasons.no-implicit-button-type: warn: a button without type submits only inside a form; elsewhere it is harmless. Reported, does not fail W11.
// reasons.heading-level: warn: skipped heading levels are an accessibility advisory (WCAG G141), not invalid markup; multiple h1 allowed.
